description: This is an Android activity class that handles permission requests related to Wear OS. It presents a UI for the user to approve or deny permissions for accessing storage, particularly in the context of wearable device communication. The activity manages user responses and communicates the decision back to the calling component, possibly affecting permission handling flow.

classes.name: WearPermissionRequestActivity
classes.description: An Android AppCompatActivity that displays a permission rationale UI for wearable device storage access, allowing the user to approve or deny the request.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Lifecycle method that sets up the activity and loads the UI layout.

methods.name: onClickApprovePermissionRequest
methods.description: Handles the user's action to approve the permission request, sets the activity result to OK, and closes the activity.

methods.name: onClickDenyPermissionRequest
methods.description: Handles the user's action to deny the permission request, sets the result to CANCELED, and finishes the activity.
